text:
maya: Quick sync — bringing up the new GPU cluster in ap-southeast-2. Need to nail the KMS/HSM sealing + IAM handoff checklist before we open provisioning.

raj: ✅ will own IAM roles and trust relationships. I sketched a minimal set: `redwood-cluster-controller`, `redwood-node-provisioner`, `redwood-secrets-reader`.

lisa: For secrets, we're using Vault via the CSI driver. Make sure the node role can call STS assume-role for Vault auth.

jorge: Noted. Is the plan to use cloud KMS keys with HSM protection for root sealing, then Vault transit for data keys?

maya: Yes — cloud KMS (HSM-backed) for key-encryption-key (KEK). Vault will generate DEKs and encrypt them with KEK. Also enable key rotation policy.

sam: Quick checklist item: ensure the KMS key policy restricts cryptographic operations to the cluster service principal + security ops role. No broad `*` access.

ida: I'll run the policy review. Share the proposed key IAM binding and the Vault role config. I can run a smoke policy test.

raj: Paste of current trust policy for node role:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

lisa: Two notes: (1) add `kms:Decrypt` scoping on the Vault role only for the KEK alias; (2) mount the CSI driver with `readOnly: true` for secrets where possible.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: kms-key-present, vault-role-created, node-role-created, kms-policy-reviewed, csi-driver-configured.

maya: Networking constraint — ap-southeast-2 has a single dedicated subnet range for GPU nodes. We need the KMS endpoints routed via NAT to limit egress scope + VPC endpoints where available.

jorge: Adding route table check to handoff: ensure `s3`, `kms`, and `sts` endpoints are reachable via VPC endpoints or approved NAT. Also verify no direct internet access from node subnet.

raj: Cost note: start with rtx-a5000-equivalent capacity at smaller node pool size to validate autoscaling. Add quota checks to the provisioning script so we don't accidentally spin up huge capacity.

ida: Running automated policy tests now (`policy-runner --env=ap-southeast-2 --target=kms,vault,iam`). Will post results in 15m.

sam: For audits: enable KMS key rotation logs and sync with SIEM. Also capture Vault seal/unseal events in audit-log.

lisa: FYI — for HSM-backed keys we need to file an exception ticket for cross-account access (brief), since HSM keys often block cross-account grants by default.

maya: Hand-off plan: once policy-runner is green and ops-bot checklist passes, Security (ida) gives approval, then we run `cluster-provision --dry-run` and do a live canary with 2 nodes.

ops-bot: checklist status: kms-key-present: pending, vault-role-created: done, node-role-created: done, kms-policy-reviewed: pending, csi-driver-configured: in-progress.

raj: I'll push the minimal kms-key policy to the infra repo in a branch: `infra/ap-southeast2/kms-minimal` and link here.

ida: policy-runner output (quick): `kms: allowed for redwood-cluster-controller`, `vault: role OK`, `iam: no wildcard principals` — a couple of warnings on missing rotation tags. Filing infra-457.

maya: Nice. After infra-457 fix, we sign off. @sam can you schedule a 30m window for the canary provisioning (low traffic)?

sam: Yep — booking 10:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll post calendar.

jorge: One last operational item: add a delayed automatic fallback to non-HSM key (software KEK) in the rollout policy in case HSM endpoint has issues — but require manual approval to switch permanently.

lisa: Document the fallback path in `runbooks/backup-sealing.md` and include commands to rotate DEKs if switching KEKs.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll update the handoff doc and ping security for final sign-off. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: handoff-ticket created: INFRA-6243. Link: https://issuetracker.internal/redwood/INFRA-6243

maya: Closing out here for now — feel free to add quick comments if you spot anything missing.
